about: Screen recordings of the OLD saved-sprite editors (frame and cleanup), recorded black-box on 2026-11-19 in headless Chrome (viewport 1280x900, scale 1) against a throwaway server (old code at 96b84fb102). The test character's sprite folder held happy.png (picture A of pixel-cases.json), full_idle.png (B), sad.jpg (A as JPEG), 'Very Happy.png' (A) and big.png (1024x1536); the persona's held happy.png (A). calls: every sprite_* and load_url_binary call in order (sprite_list left out), with the step that caused it; sprite_upload's image is replaced by image:N, an index into images (decoded to RGBA with the same PNG decoder, zlib-deflated base64, sha256 of the raw RGBA). pointer: the exact client coordinates sent for each click or stroke (the canvas box's left/top + (x + 0.5) * scale). shown: status/footer text, toasts and control states at each step. files: the sprite folder afterwards (name:size). Wand background clicks are at (6, 6): the stage's rounded corners swallow clicks on the canvas's corner pixels at 100%, so (2, 2) can't be clicked; it's the same connected background.
